Name: Pokemon Eggventure - Day Care
Author: Parme69
Description:
[center][b][size=6]🥚 Pokémon Eggventure - Day Care[/size][/b][/center]
[center][/center]
[center]Turn your farm into the ultimate Pokémon Day Care![/center]
[center][/center]
[center]Hatch over [b]1,100 Pokémon[/b], hunt for rare Eggs, discover Shinies, raise your companions through multiple evolution stages and build the ultimate Pokémon ranch.[/center]

[line]


[size=5][b]⭐ Overview[/b][/size]

Pokémon Eggventure expands Stardew Valley's farming experience by introducing an entirely new Pokémon-based livestock system.

Transform your farm into a true Pokémon Day Care by purchasing Pokémon from Marnie or discovering Pokémon Eggs throughout Stardew Valley.

Raise them, watch them evolve, collect unique Pokémon products, craft powerful new resources, and enjoy a brand-new farming progression inspired by the Pokémon universe.

Rather than replacing Stardew Valley's content, Eggventure adds a complete Pokémon ecosystem that seamlessly integrates into your farming adventure.

[line]


[size=5][b]⭐ Features[/b][/size]

[list]
[*]Over [b]1,100 Pokémon[/b] (Shinies, Regional Forms, Primal, Origin, Alternate Forms, and more)[/*]
[*]Purchase Pokémon from Marnie[/*]
[*]Discover Pokémon Eggs throughout Stardew Valley[/*]
[*]Pokémon Incubation System[/*]
[*]Baby → Adult → Final Evolution progression[/*]
[*]Friendship evolutions at 2.5 Hearts[/*]
[*]Pokémon-exclusive products[/*]
[*]Brand-new Artisan Goods[/*]
[*]Special quests and Museum rewards[/*]
[*]Designed for future expansions[/*]
[/list]
[line]


[size=5][b]🐄 Build Your Pokémon Ranch[/b][/size]

Expand your farm with Pokémon companions.

Visit Marnie to adopt Pokémon, or discover rare Eggs during your adventures. Every Pokémon grows, evolves and contributes to your farm through exclusive products and progression systems.

Whether you enjoy collecting, breeding or completing your Pokédex, your farm will gradually become a thriving Pokémon Ranch.

[line]


[size=5][b]🥚 Egg Hunting[/b][/size]

Not every Pokémon can be purchased.

Many species can only be obtained by discovering their Eggs throughout Stardew Valley.

Eggs are rewarded through many gameplay activities, encouraging exploration across the entire game.

Eggs can be found through:

[list]
[*]Foraging & Artifact Spots (Vanilla and SVE maps)[/*]
[*]Mines, Skull Cavern, Quarry, Volcano and Hard Mode Mines[/*]
[*]Fishing & Panning[/*]
[*]Breaking Geodes, Golden Coconuts and Artifact Troves[/*]
[*]Shaking or Cutting Trees[/*]
[*]Traveling Cart[/*]
[*]Garbage Cans[/*]
[*]Bee Houses[/*]
[*]Special Quests & Festivals[/*]
[*]Friendship Rewards[/*]
[*]Resource Trains[/*]
[*]And much more...[/*]
[/list]
Each activity has its own Pokémon pool based on your skills and progression, making exploration rewarding throughout the entire game.

[line]


[size=5][b]🐣 Incubation[/b][/size]

After finding an Egg, place it inside a Pokémon Incubator.

Each Egg has its own incubation time depending on its rarity.

Rarities include:

[list]
[*]Very Common[/*]
[*]Common[/*]
[*]Rare[/*]
[*]Very Rare[/*]
[*]Legendary[/*]
[/list]
Every hatch also has a chance to produce a Shiny Pokémon.

[line]


[size=5][b]❤️ Raise Your Pokémon[/b][/size]

Your Pokémon grow alongside your farm.
Each companion progresses through multiple life stages.
Most Pokémon naturally mature over time, while their final evolutions require friendship, rewarding players who care for them every day.

[line]


[size=5][b]⚡ Products & Artisan Goods[/b][/size]

Instead of traditional animal products, Pokémon provide resources inspired by their elemental typings.

Examples include:

[list]
[*]Dragon Fang[/*]
[*]Mystic Water[/*]
[*]Black Glasses[/*]
[*]Charcoal[/*]
[*]Miracle Seed[/*]
[*]Metal Coat[/*]
[*]Never-Melt Ice[/*]
[*]...and dozens more.[/*]
[/list]
These materials can be processed using exclusive artisan machines to create powerful crafting materials and advanced resources, opening an entirely new production chain.

[line]


[size=5][b]📜 Special Quests[/b][/size]

Eggventure introduces exclusive Pokémon-themed quests.

Progress through the mod to unlock:

[list]
[*]New crafting recipes[/*]
[*]Incubation mechanics[/*]
[*]Gameplay systems[/*]
[*]Unique rewards[/*]
[/list]
Additional quests and progression features will continue to be added through future updates.

[line]


[size=5][b]🔧 Dependencies[/b][/size]

[b]Required Mods[/b]

[list]
[*]Extra Animal Configs (EAC)[/*]
[*]Extra Machine Configs (EMC)[/*]
[*]Item Extensions[/*]
[*]Farm Type Manager[/*]
[/list]
Please ensure all required mods are installed and updated before reporting issues.

[b]Recommended[/b]

[list]
[*]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)[/*]
[*]Pokémon Eggventure - Follow Me[/*]
[*]Stardew Valley Expanded + Grampleton Fields[/*]
[*]Jen's Mega Coop and Barn[/*]
[/list]
[line]


[size=5][b]🔗 Compatibility[/b][/size]

Pokémon Eggventure has been designed as the foundation of a larger Pokémon ecosystem.
Compatible with future Pokémon Eggventure expansions and Stardew Valley Expanded.
Most content mods remain compatible provided they do not modify the same Pokémon content or related assets.

[line]


[size=5][b]📥 Installation[/b][/size]

[list=1]
[*]Install all required dependencies.[/*]
[*]Download Pokémon Eggventure.[/*]
[*]Extract the mod into your Stardew Valley Mods folder.[/*]
[*]Launch the game using SMAPI.[/*]
[*]Start your Pokémon adventure![/*]
[/list]
[line]


[size=5][b]❓ Frequently Asked Questions[/b][/size]

[b]Can I use this on an existing save?[/b]

Yes. Existing saves are fully supported, although starting a new farm is recommended for the best experience.

[b]How do I get more Pokémon?[/b]

Purchase them from Marnie or discover Pokémon Eggs while exploring Stardew Valley.

[b]Can I catch every Pokémon?[/b]

Over [b]1,100 Pokémon[/b] are already available, with even more content planned through future expansions.

[line]
